season.source: Tide and stream: NOAA SSCOFS (Salish Sea and Columbia River Operational Forecast System), the nowcast for each hour. Wind and gusts: NOAA HRRR 3 km analyses, one an hour. Both from NOAA Open Data on AWS.

forecast.source: Wind: HRRR 12z cycle of 25 Jun 2025. Tide: SSCOFS 15z cycle, its station forecast nearest Friday Harbor. Both as issued.

terrain.source: Terrarium elevation tiles (Mapzen, AWS Open Data).

wind.note: HRRR 10 m wind in tenths of a metre per second, blowing toward east (u) and north (v), and surface gust speed (g).

tide.note: Water level in metres above the model datum, close to mean sea level.
